title: サーバマネジメント入門
subtitle: Introduction to Server Management
teachers:
SATOU Fujio
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
In this course, students will:
(1) Learn basic Linux operations such as files and directories, document creation, program compilation, and webpage publishing.
(2) Perform these operations by keyboard commands.
(3) Learn to use basic network commands such as ssh and sftp.
advice:
This is a basic course on Linux operations, within which we will cover the following materials:

1. Linux command line operation
 - files and directories
 - commands

2. Text editors vi and emacs
 - create, edit, and save Japanese documents
 - create, compile, and execute a C program
 - create webpages and publish them on a web server

3. Network
 - basic network commands such as ssh and sftp
 - client-server system

              In this course, students will:

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This is a basic course on Linux operations, within which we will cover the following materials:

1. Linux command line operation
 - files and directories
 - commands

2. Text editors vi and emacs
 - create, edit, and save Japanese documents
 - create, compile, and execute a C program
 - create webpages and publish them on a web server

3. Network
 - basic network commands such as ssh and sftp
 - client-server system
